blocks.note: Form adverbs in -mente from the appropriate adjective base while retaining lexical accent marks.
Coordinate consecutive manner adverbs by marking -mente only on the final member of the joined series.
Replace heavy -mente forms with established manner phrases and place those phrases beside the action they modify.
Choose deictic place adverbs from speaker, hearer, distance, movement, register, and conventional-expression context.
Separate low manner or pitch with bajo, downward or lower location with abajo, and relational position with debajo.
Distinguish a static position behind with detrás from backward direction, rear location, and elapsed time with atrás.
Use aún for still, yet, and an increased degree, and aun for even or including.
Interpret ya from tense, polarity, discourse state, and intonation instead of assigning it one fixed English equivalent.
Contrast entonces as the relevant time or resulting situation with luego as a later step in a sequence.
